title: Returned Checks, Returned ACH Payments and Disputed Card Payments — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
When the bank returns a check or ACH payment made on a Service Accounts and Repair Orders repair order, the payment's credit is taken back by a returned-payment entry pointing at the payment, and the tier's returned payment fee is charged on the same repair order as a returned payment fee.

A disputed card payment is taken back the same way but draws no returned payment fee. A returned payment fee is charged once per returned payment.

| Payment taken back | Returned-payment entry | Returned payment fee |
|---|---|---|
| Check | Yes | Yes, once |
| ACH | Yes | Yes, once |
| Card payment disputed | Yes | No |

**Hypothetical.** A 410.00 check returned unpaid puts 410.00 back on what is owed on that repair order and adds the 30.00 returned payment fee there; a 410.00 card payment taken back on a dispute puts back the 410.00 only.
